2608.25936.title: One Symptom, Three Levers: A Critical Review of On-Policy Self-Distillation
2608.25936.paper_summary: On-policy distillation trains a language model on its own generations while a teacher scores them token by token. It combines the dense supervision of imitation learning with the on-policy sampling of reinforcement learning. But it requires a second, larger model to act as teacher. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) removes that cost. The teacher is the model itself, conditioned on privileged information the student will not have at test time, such as a reference solution, a plan, or environment feedback. The teacher is no stronger than the student, only better informed. Early results were promising, with accuracy comparable to reinforcement learning at a fraction of the generated tokens. But the same asymmetry that produces the signal also biases it. One failure mode now dominates the field: collapse, the progressive narrowing of the set of reasoning paths the model can produce. Collapse is not specific to OPSD, though privileged information aggravates it. This review treats collapse as a symptom governed by three levers: (i) where the signal is applied, that is, how tokens are weighted; (ii) what the teacher is shown, that is, the nature of the privileged information; and (iii) when the signal changes, that is, the teacher's dynamics and the decay of guidance. We restrict our scope to mathematical reasoning, where the method originated and where its failure modes are best documented. We report no new experiments. The contribution is structural: a shared vocabulary for phenomena named differently across papers, and a clear line between what is settled and what is still disputed.
2608.25936.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾中，語言模型在其自身生成的內容上進行訓練，而教師則逐字評分。這結合了模仿學習的密集監督與強化學習的政策取樣。但它需要一個第二個、更大的模型作為教師。政策自蒸餾（OPSD）消除了這一成本。教師是模型本身，依賴於學生在測試時不會擁有的特權信息，例如參考解決方案、計劃或環境反饋。教師並不比學生更強，只是信息更充分。早期結果令人鼓舞，準確性與強化學習相當，但生成的標記數量卻少得多。然而，產生信號的相同不對稱性也會使其產生偏見。現在一種失敗模式主導了這個領域：崩潰，即模型能生成的推理路徑集的逐漸縮小。崩潰並不特定於OPSD，儘管特權信息會加劇這一現象。本綜述將崩潰視為由三個杠杆控制的症狀：（i）信號應用的位置，即標記的權重；（ii）教師所看到的內容，即特權信息的性質；以及（iii）信號變化的時機，即教師的動態和指導的衰減。我們將範圍限制在數學推理上，這是該方法的起源所在，也是其失敗模式文獻記載最為充分的地方。我們不報告任何新的實驗。貢獻在於結構性：為在不同論文中以不同名稱命名的現象提供共享的詞彙，以及清晰的界限，區分已解決的問題和仍然存在爭議的問題。
